mkdir -p programs && cat > programs/task-e1b24de6.py <<'PY'
def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        # A row with a single transition from one solid band to another marks
        # the second (right-hand) band as color 1. Uniform rows are unchanged.
        changes = [i for i in range(1, len(row)) if row[i] != row[i-1]]
        if len(changes) == 1:
            cut = changes[0]
            if len(set(row[:cut])) == 1 and len(set(row[cut:])) == 1:
                out[r][cut:] = [1] * (len(row)-cut)
    return out
PY
